verdict.rationale: An IP office's online services could plausibly offer a programmatic API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only web forms, One Login-gated online filing, email and post rails, and a search host that blocks automated agents at robots.txt. Nothing shows a documented API, let alone one matching the UI's capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
